_readme: THE TRADE-PRESSURE RUN, 2026-08-18. The experiment TRAJECTORY.md called
for: make a deal worth striking, and see whether the verb gets reached for
on its own.
WHAT CHANGED SINCE THE 2026-08-17 DUO RUN, same seats, same characters:
ATTENTION IS EVENT-DRIVEN. Being spoken to, shot, or made an offer now
wakes a mind ahead of its cadence (wakecheck 20/20), a conversation
holds a 12 s reconsider window open, a direct question rides the brief
as an unanswered debt, and a reply outranks the speech ration.
DEALS ARE PINNED. An offer on the table stays in every brief until
settled or lapsed — it cannot sample out of memory mid-walk.
THE PROMPT TEACHES CONVERSATION. Answer what you have not answered,
a question back is a fine answer, open with a name to speak TO somebody.
THE PRESSURE. SCARCE=on is the hard winter — less of everything, pulled
into the good ground. Hungry from the start, and the characters collide:
one hoards and prices everything, one asks for what it needs. On
2026-08-17, in a GENTLE valley, this pair still produced 'need that fire.
meat for the use of it' and 'mine. gold if you want a share' — priced in
gold neither held a coin of. The only way to a coin is each other.
WHAT DECIDES THE EXPERIMENT. If offer/give/accept appear unprompted, the
2026-08-17 suspicion was right: the verbs were fine and the world was not
worth a deal. If the pair STILL bargains only in words under this much
pressure with this much attention, the fault is in how the brief offers
the verbs, and that is the next fix — a different one.
Seat settings per roster-grok46duo.json and the probe behind it:
maxTokens 6000 or 4.6 is cut off every call; 60/75 staggered or a 26 s
thinker becomes a queue. No scripted control: two minds, one question.
No keys in this file. keyEnv is the NAME of an env var.

players.name: Fingal
players.character: You hoard. What you pick up is yours and you do not hand it over for nothing — but you will name a price for anything, and you drive a hard bargain. Gold interests you more than company.

players.name: Ailsa
players.character: You are blunt and you ask for what you need rather than going without. You would rather owe somebody than starve, and you say plainly what you think a thing is worth.
